title: Notifications of one chat
summary: Picks how one group or DM notifies. A group has three modes: only what is for you (quiet, the default), all messages, mute (ADR 0026). A DM has two: all messages and mute (ADR 0141).

mode.description: quiet: RoomNotificationMode mentionsAndKeywordsOnly in a group. all: allMessages. mute: mute. mentionsLegacy: mentionsAndKeywordsOnly in a DM, set before ADR 0141.

title.description: String key: bipe_app_notify_quiet, bipe_app_notify_all, bipe_app_notify_mute or bipe_app_notify_mentions_legacy.

footer.description: String key of the line under the option: bipe_app_notify_quiet_footer for quiet.

isDefault.description: true when this mode is the account default for this kind of chat, so choosing it removes the room rule.

options.description: Group: quiet, all, mute. DM: all, mute, plus mentionsLegacy only while it is the current mode.

saving.description: true while the change goes out. The options are locked.

appear.effect: Client.getNotificationSettings, then NotificationSettings.getRoomNotificationSettings and NotificationSettings.getDefaultRoomNotificationMode, both with isEncrypted from RoomInfo.encryptionState and isOneToOne set to isDm (the one DM test of ADR 0141, never the member count).

mode.description: The new mode. mentionsLegacy cannot be chosen.

choose.effect: When mode is the account default: NotificationSettings.restoreDefaultRoomNotificationMode. Else NotificationSettings.setRoomNotificationMode. From mute to another mode: NotificationSettings.unmuteRoom first. A failure shows bipe_app_notify_error and puts the old choice back.

notes: Quiet is mentions and keywords plus the account override rule chat.bipe.poll_start (event type *.poll.start), so a new poll notifies in a quiet group (groups.md, #97). BipeQuietGroups sets that rule and the group default once per account (libraries/bipe groups/BipeQuietGroups.kt). This screen never writes the poll rule.

Quiet in an encrypted group needs the server to push encrypted events (NotificationSettings.canHomeserverPushEncryptedEventToDevice, Synapse msc4028). Without it, mentions-only silences the group. While the answer is false, the group shows only all and mute, and a group whose rule is already mentions-only shows as quiet with no footer. Parity note: inert until Synapse pushes encrypted events (#118).

DM (ADR 0141): only all and mute. A DM with mentions-only from before keeps that server rule and shows bipe_app_notify_mentions_legacy as the current option until the user picks another. Then that row goes away.
Words: Silenciar and Todas as mensagens come from ADR 0141. The row in group-details shows the title of the current option.
The account defaults per chat kind (groups, DMs) are in the notifications settings spec (bipe-chat/bipe#565), not here.
